initialize_formative_memories: create a FormativeMemoriesInitializer component that generates backstories for each player entity in a Concordia game simulation
generate_backstory_episodes: call generate_backstory_episodes to produce formative life story episodes for a named player character using an LLM
configure_player_specific_memories: build a FormativeMemoriesInitializer with player-specific memories and context mapped per player name for personalized backstory generation
pre_act_game_master_switching: use pre_act to run initialization once then return the next game master name to transfer control after setup
review_component_state_management: review the get_state and set_state methods to persist and restore the initialized flag for the component
